info.title: SecureGate API
info.description:
REST API for **SecureGate** — a Smart Contractor & Visitor Access Management
System for manufacturing facilities.

## Authentication

There are three separate auth mechanisms, all cookie- or header-based. None
of them use an `Authorization: Bearer <user token>` header, so Swagger UI's
"Authorize" button only covers the cron endpoint.

| Mechanism | Applies to | How it is obtained |
|---|---|---|
| `staff_token` cookie (JWT, HS256, 8h) | everything under `/api/staff/*` | `POST /api/staff/login` |
| `track_session_{trackingToken}` cookie (1h) | `/api/visit`, `/api/track/document/reupload` | `POST /api/track/verify` |
| `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET` | `/api/cron/document-expiry` | environment variable |

Because the staff and tracking sessions are **httpOnly cookies**, Swagger UI
cannot set them from JavaScript. To exercise those endpoints from Swagger UI:

1. Call `POST /api/staff/login` (or `POST /api/track/verify`) from the same
   browser — the browser stores the cookie automatically.
2. Serve this spec from the **same origin** as the API so the cookie is sent.

Otherwise use `curl -c/-b` or Postman, which handle cookie jars directly.

## Roles

`/api/staff/*` endpoints are gated per-role. Each operation documents the
roles it accepts; a caller with a valid session but the wrong role also
receives **401** (not 403 — the implementation does not distinguish).

## Conventions

- All errors return `{ "message": "<human readable>" }` unless noted.
  `POST /api/register` additionally returns a per-field `errors` map on 400.
- All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. Rendered dates/times elsewhere in
  the product are converted to WIB (UTC+7) at the presentation layer.
- `trackingToken` in a URL path is **encrypted** (see `lib/token-crypto.ts`);
  the same value in a request body is the raw token.

tags.name: Public — Registration
tags.description: Unauthenticated endpoints used by contractors and visitors.

tags.name: Public — Tracking
tags.description: Self-service status tracking, gated by email verification.

post.description:
Creates a `PENDING` registration and uploads its documents to blob
storage. Multipart form; file field names are lowercase keys, while the
resulting document records use the uppercase `DocumentType` enum.

**Required files** — `face` and `ktp` for both types; `bpjs`, `sio`, and
`sia` additionally required when `type=CONTRACTOR`.

Files are validated three ways: MIME allowlist, 5 MB size cap, and magic
byte inspection (the declared MIME must match actual file content).

A blacklisted email is refused with **403**. If a `REJECTED` registration
already exists for the same `(email, type)`, it is deleted so the
applicant can re-apply; a `PENDING` or `APPROVED` one yields **409**.

201.description:
Created. A confirmation email containing the tracking link is sent,
and HSE/HR are notified via Telegram. The tracking token is **not**
returned in the response body — it is delivered by email, and also
set as a short-lived `pending_tracking_token` cookie (5 min).

400.description: Missing fields, or file validation failed.

example.sio: SIO: file content does not match its type

example.message: This email is not eligible to register. Please contact our HSE team for more information.

post.description:
Returns every registration belonging to an email so the applicant can
pick one. The returned `trackingToken` values are **encrypted** and are
meant to be used directly as the `/track-status/{url}` path segment.

trackingToken.description: Encrypted token, safe to place in a URL.

404.description: No registration found with this email.

post.summary: Verify email ownership for a tracking token
post.description:
Proves the caller owns the email behind a registration, then issues a
`track_session_{token}` httpOnly cookie valid for **1 hour**. That cookie
is what authorises `POST /api/visit` and
`POST /api/track/document/reupload`.

Note the asymmetry: `token` here is the **raw** `trackingToken`, whereas
the value in `/track-status/{url}` URLs is encrypted.

Navigating to the tracking search page clears every `track_session_*`
cookie, so each registration must be re-verified per visit.

401.description: Email does not match this registration.

post.summary: Replace one or more of your documents
post.description:
Replaces documents **in place** — one row per document type, always. The
existing record is overwritten (new `filePath`, verification reset to
zero, `replacedAt` stamped) rather than superseded by a new row, and the
superseded blob is deleted. The replacement is recorded in the audit
trail as `DOCUMENT_REPLACED`, which is the only place the previous file
path survives.

Side effect: the parent registration returns to `PENDING` and its
`rejectionReason` is cleared. This is how a `REJECTED` applicant re-enters
the review queue without filling in the whole form again.

Form field names are the uppercase `DocumentType` values, and only types
that currently exist on the registration are accepted.

token.description: Raw tracking token. Must match the `track_session_{token}` cookie.

201.description: Documents replaced and resubmitted for review.

message.example: Documents uploaded and submitted for review

400.description: Token missing, no files submitted, or a file failed MIME/size validation.

example.message: SIO: file must be under 5 MB

post.description:
Creates a `PENDING` visit for an **APPROVED** registration. Blocked with
**403** if the registration is not approved, and with **400** if any
active document is expired.

`windowStart`/`windowEnd` are `HH:MM` strings interpreted in WIB and
combined with `visitDate`.

token.description: Raw tracking token. Must match the `track_session_{token}` cookie.

400.description: Missing fields, invalid window, or an expired document blocks new visits.

post.description:
Verifies credentials (bcrypt) and sets a `staff_token` httpOnly cookie
containing an HS256 JWT valid for **8 hours**. The JWT payload carries
`id`, `email`, `name`, and `role` — every `/api/staff/*` route reads its
role gate from there.

The token itself is never returned in the response body.

401.description: Invalid email or password, or the account is inactive.

get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

`q` powers the registration picker in the blacklist-add flow — a
blacklist entry must be created from a verified registration rather than
a free-typed identity. When `q` is supplied the result set is capped at
20; without it, all registrations are returned.

get.summary: Get a registration with its active documents
get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Only `isActive: true` documents are included. Superseded rows remain in
the table for history but are filtered out, otherwise a re-uploaded type
would appear twice.

patch.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Only a `PENDING` registration can be reviewed — anything else returns
**409**. There is deliberately **no un-reject path**: a rejected
applicant either replaces documents via
`POST /api/track/document/reupload` (which returns the record to
`PENDING`) or registers again, which deletes the rejected row.

`APPROVE` additionally requires every active document to be verified.

Writes `REGISTRATION_APPROVED` / `REGISTRATION_REJECTED` to the audit
log and emails the applicant.

400.description: Invalid action, or `REJECT` without a reason.

409.description: Already reviewed, or unverified documents block approval.

example.message: Verify all documents before approving: SIO, SIA

patch.summary: Verify or unverify a document (review screen)
patch.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Only editable while the parent registration is `PENDING` — otherwise
**403**. `expiryDate` must be in the future.

403.description: Cannot modify documents of a reviewed registration.

patch.summary: Verify or unverify a document (monitoring screen)
patch.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Unlike `PATCH /api/staff/documents/{id}`, this endpoint works regardless
of registration status, and carries the auto-transition logic:

- **Verify** — if the registration is `PENDING` and every active document
  is now verified, it is auto-promoted to `APPROVED` (`autoApproved: true`).
- **Unverify** — an `APPROVED` registration is demoted back to `PENDING`.

expiryDate.description: Required when verifying; must be a future date.

autoApproved.description: Present on verify. True when this call promoted the registration to APPROVED.

400.description: Expiry date missing or not in the future.

get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Proxies the private blob so the storage URL is never exposed to the
browser. Errors are **plain text**, not JSON.

404.description: Document not found in DB, or blob missing (plain text body).

get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Active documents of `APPROVED` registrations, enriched with expiry
status and sorted by urgency.

A document whose expiry date is **today** counts as `EXPIRED`, not
"0 days left" — the threshold is `daysLeft <= 0`. `EXPIRING_SOON` spans
1–7 days. `REVIEW` overrides expiry status for documents HSE has not yet
verified.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
- `all` (default) — everything
- `review` — awaiting verification
- `expiring7` — the whole EXPIRING_SOON window (1–7 days)
- `expiring1` — the most urgent slice (1 day or less)
- `expired` — already expired

get.summary: Get a visit with its registration and active documents

patch.summary: Approve, reject, or re-scope a visit
patch.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

`APPROVE` requires every active document to be verified **and** to carry
a valid future expiry date. `UPDATE_ZONES` changes `authorizedZones` on
an already-approved visit and logs `VISIT_ZONES_UPDATED`.

400.description: Invalid action, missing zones, or documents lack a valid expiry date.

409.description: Wrong visit state, or unverified documents block approval.

post.summary: Validate a scanned QR before granting entry
post.description:
Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Read-mostly pre-flight for the check-in console. Returns everything the
operator needs to decide: identity, photo, zones, risk assessment,
schedule window, and per-document expiry status.

**Blacklist is a hard stop.** When blocked, the response is still `200`
with `blocked: true, blacklisted: true` and no override is offered — and
the attempt is persisted as a `DENIED` CheckEvent plus a
`BLACKLIST_BLOCKED` audit entry.

`needsOverride: true` signals an expired document, which *is*
overridable with written justification (FR-014).

`token` is the per-visit `visitToken`, not the registration-level
`trackingToken`.

200.description:
Validation result. Note that a *refusal* is also `200` — inspect
`blocked` and `blacklisted` rather than the status code.

post.description:
Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

The committing half of check-in. Re-verifies the blacklist server-side —
it never trusts the client's earlier `validate` result.

Expired documents return **422** with `needsOverride: true`; retry with
`override: true` and a `justification` to proceed. Blacklist matches can
never be overridden.

403.description: Blacklisted, or the visit is not approved. Not overridable.

422.description: Blocked but overridable — expired documents or outside the schedule window.

post.description:
Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Records an explicit operator refusal as a `DENIED` CheckEvent.
`token` is the scanned `visitToken`.

Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Called by the Security roster screen. `POST /api/staff/checkout` is a
second route with identical behaviour, used by the HSE/HR "Who's Inside"
screen — both are live; neither is dead code.

Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

Functionally equivalent to `POST /api/staff/checkin/checkout`. Both are
genuinely in use: this one backs the HSE/HR "Who's Inside" screen, the
nested one backs the Security roster screen. Consolidating them onto a
single route would be a reasonable cleanup, but neither is dead.

get.summary: Live roster of people currently inside
Who is inside, grouped by zone

get.description:
Roles: `SECURITY_OPERATOR`, `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

With `q` shorter than 2 characters, returns the 15 most recent distinct
visitors instead of performing a search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term. Under 2 characters falls back to "recent visitors".

get.summary: Full check-in history for one person

get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`, `SECURITY_OPERATOR`.

Read access is deliberately wider than write access — Security needs the
watchlist but must not be able to edit it.

post.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `HR_ADMIN`.

**`registrationId` is mandatory by design** — `fullName` and `email` are
derived from that record, never accepted from the caller. This makes it
impossible to blacklist an arbitrary typed-in email; only a person whose
identity the system has already verified through submitted documents.

Distinct from rejecting a registration: rejection closes one application
and is reversible by re-applying, whereas a blacklist entry is a
facility-wide block enforced at the gate that no operator can override,
and it also prevents new registrations.

Side effects: `BLACKLIST_ADDED` audit entry, Telegram alert to HSE,
in-app notification, and an email to the affected person.

id.description: Blacklist entry ID (not the registration ID).

400.description: Name missing or invalid risk level.
Name missing or invalid risk level.

get.description: Any authenticated staff role. Read state is tracked per user.

post.summary: Mark all notifications read for the current user

get.description:
Roles: `HSE_ADMIN`, `SECURITY_OPERATOR`.

One-click PDF roster of everyone currently inside, with zones, check-in
time, and overstay flags (FR-009). The generation timestamp is printed in
**WIB**.

If the live query fails, the endpoint falls back to the last stored
roster snapshot and the PDF is stamped with a red `FALLBACK SNAPSHOT —
last updated ...` banner so a stale list can never be mistaken for a
live one (FR-009A).

Returns a binary PDF, not JSON.

post.description:
Role: `SYSTEM_ADMIN` only. Password is bcrypt-hashed (cost 12+).
Logs `STAFF_CREATED`.

400.description: Missing fields, invalid role, or password too short.

patch.description:
Role: `SYSTEM_ADMIN` only. Any subset of fields may be sent.
Logs `STAFF_UPDATED`.

password.description: Omit to leave the password unchanged.

400.description: Nothing to update, invalid role, or password too short.

get.description:
Manual/ops trigger for FR-010. The automatic daily run (08:00 WIB) is
scheduled in-process via `node-cron` in `instrumentation.ts`, since the
app is deployed on a self-managed VPS rather than a platform with cron.

Notifies HSE/HR via Telegram for documents at exactly **30, 14, or 7**
days from expiry.

This is the only endpoint that uses an `Authorization` header, so it is
the only one Swagger UI's "Authorize" button can drive.

notified.description: Documents that hit a threshold and triggered notifications.

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token, or `CRON_SECRET` is unset.

staffSessionCookie.name: staff_token
staffSessionCookie.description:
HS256 JWT, 8-hour expiry, set by `POST /api/staff/login`. **httpOnly**,
so Swagger UI cannot attach it programmatically — log in from the same
browser and serve this spec from the same origin, or use curl/Postman.

trackSessionCookie.name: track_session_{trackingToken}
trackSessionCookie.description:
Per-registration session cookie, 1-hour expiry, set by
`POST /api/track/verify`. The cookie **name** embeds the raw tracking
token, so each registration carries its own cookie — this is why it
cannot be expressed as a fixed name here. **httpOnly.**

Unauthorized.description:
No valid session, **or** a valid session whose role is not permitted —
the implementation does not distinguish between the two.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with the current state of the resource.

DocExpiryStatus.description:
`EXPIRED` covers `daysLeft <= 0` — a document expiring **today** is
already expired, not "0 days left". `EXPIRING_SOON` spans 1–7 days.

daysLeft.description: Negative when already past expiry; `0` means expiring today.

visitToken.description: The value encoded in the visitor's QR code.

photoPath.description: Shown to the operator for manual visual comparison (no automated face matching).

risk.description: Deterministic rule-based assessment (not a trained model).

needsOverride.description: True when an active document is expired. Overridable with justification.

ValidateBlocked.description:
Entry refused. Still returned with HTTP **200** — inspect `blocked`.
When `blacklisted` is true there is no override path at all.

message.example: BLACKLISTED — Entry Denied. No override available.

registrationId.description: Nullable in the schema, so an entry is not structurally bound to a registration.

company.description: Resolved from the linked registration; present on the list endpoint only.

isRead.description: Per-user, derived from the NotificationRead join table.
